title: Index every MUR 7157 filing and map claim-to-response provenance
summary: Recover each complaint, addendum, respondent filing, exhibit, counsel report, certification, and notification in MUR 7157 as a document-level provenance graph with stable source IDs and claim-to-response links.

data.query: FEC MUR 7157 complaint addendum responses exhibits certification factual legal analysis document inventory
data.research_question: For each allegation in MUR 7157, which exact complaint or exhibit asserted it, which respondent filing answered it, what evidence did OGC rely on, and what final Commission finding disposed of it?
objectives: Create one stable source record per FEC document in MUR 7157
Capture document date, role, respondent or complainant, FEC URL, and content hash where retrievable
Map the Donald Ducks, paid-protester, Wisconsin Fall Plan, and shared-strategy allegations to the exact complaint/exhibit and response records
Separate allegation, respondent denial, OGC analysis, Commission finding, and later litigation evidence
preferred_sources: Federal Election Commission MUR 7157 document repository
FEC certifications and Factual and Legal Analysis
